question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql: SELECT w1.name AS winner_name, w2.name AS loser_name FROM Matches m JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id WHERE m.title_id = '23153' AND m.title_change = 0 AND m.duration = '00:43' LIMIT 5
